body:
I'll go with "draw updates" since its based on some values set in the draw notification. Not really about the time it takes and you shouldn't need to queue redraw.
It's mostly to tell users that they can't do things like call `adjust_viewport_to_caret()` and then this right after.
(The vertical offset and left and right limits are based on draw at least, other values are accounted for immediately.)
